description: Stars: Wonders of the World by NoooN, the winner of the PC demo competition at Assembly '95, running from its original files in your browser.
about: Stars: Wonders of the World is NoooN's demo for MS-DOS, which won the PC demo competition at Assembly '95, held from 10 to 13 August 1995 in Helsinki. Its NFO says NoooN made it in five days.
This is its final release, of September 1995, which added the Sound Blaster and Sound Blaster 16 to the party version's Gravis UltraSound.
It takes no keys: Space and Escape neither skip nor stop it.
released: Assembly '95: first in the PC demo competition, with 3,646 points. The final release followed in September 1995.
credits: System and special effects by Karl, 3D motion by Barti, script and graphics by Ra, music by Groo; sound code by LCA, and PMODE by Tran (STARS.NFO).
terms: None found: STARS.NFO only asks the boards that carry NoooN's releases to “allow to any user to download all our productions for free”. Rights holders can reach DosKit's owner below.
accuracy: It takes no keys, so it can be neither skipped nor stopped: picking another app leaves it.
DosKit gives it the Gravis UltraSound its NFO recommends.

Its parts come within about 0.3 to 0.7 seconds of a capture made on a Pentium 120 with a Gravis UltraSound while the device keeps up; on a busy one it can fall about 2 seconds behind where it loads a part.
The BARTi and KARL name cards change places from run to run, which seems to be the demo's own doing.
Its last two minutes, and whether it returns to DOS, have not been seen in DosKit.
Mono: js-dos mixes the Gravis UltraSound's two channels into one.
imageAlt: Stars: Wonders of the World's wasp, running in DosKit
